node.title: Re^3: Image::Thumbnail work under windows but not on linux
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
PM doesn't seem to enforce any font on its 

 tags, so it should be using whatever is the default fixed-width font in your browser, so you should be able to change it in your browser's settings. If you're on Windows, I like the new "Consolas" font, and on Ubuntu, "Ubuntu Mono" isn't bad.
